blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte is set to present corporate lawyer Suzette Balucanag-Punay as its third witness on the 42nd day of her impeachment trial on Wednesday. Balucanag-Punay serves as corporate counsel of GenCorp Industries Inc. and Metro City Chow Foods Corp. She was initially scheduled to testify earlier but her appearance was postponed due to an MRI appointment last Monday./dp READ: Highlights: Day 41 of Sara Duterte impeachment trial | Nov. 10, 2026...
